title: Test-Driven Approaches to Software Engineering with Large Language Models: A Survey of Phases, Tasks, and Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2609.12012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tests increasingly participate in the decisions made by large language models and software engineering agents. They specify intended behavior, guide program construction and repair, select candidates, constrain transformations, and provide execution evidence for software analysis. These uses draw on test-driven development, yet differ substantially in test order, oracle availability, editable artifacts, and the role of execution. We present a structured scoping survey organized around the question of what decision a test changes. The review integrates 87 research and supporting records, with method- or protocol-level extraction for 83 records, alongside a separate collection of five practice resources. We distinguish the Red--Green--Refactor cycle from test-conditioned generation, execution-guided refinement, test-mediated analysis, and evaluation-only testing. translated_title: 面向大型语言模型软件工程的测试驱动方法：阶段、任务与智能体技能综述
translated_abstract: 测试日益参与到大型语言模型和软件工程智能体的决策过程中。测试用于规定预期行为、指导程序的构建与修复、筛选候选方案、约束代码转换，并为软件分析提供执行证据。这些用途借鉴了测试驱动开发的思想，但在测试顺序、判定标准的可获得性、可编辑工件以及执行所扮演的角色等方面存在显著差异。本文提出了一项结构化的范围综述，围绕“测试改变了什么决策”这一核心问题展开。该综述整合了87项研究及支持性记录，其中对83项记录进行了方法或协议层面的信息提取，并另行收集了五份实践资源。我们区分了“红—绿—重构”循环与测试条件生成、执行引导的精化、测试中介的分析以及仅用于评估的测试，随后对代码生成、修复、翻译、重构、克隆检测等任务进行了比较。
tldr: 本综述以“测试改变了什么决策”为核心问题，系统梳理了87项研究，区分了测试驱动开发与测试条件生成、执行引导精化等不同模式，并全面比较了大型语言模型在各类软件工程任务中的阶段、任务与智能体技能。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews 87 studies around the question of what decisions tests change, distinguishing the Red-Green-Refactor cycle from test-conditioned generation, execution-guided refinement, and other modes, while comprehensively comparing phases, tasks, and agent skills of LLM-based software engineering across various tasks.
